inputs_read: Only components/ library; no builder outputs, examples, research, previous designs or peer reviews read.

verdicts.PASS: Direct evidence satisfies a cited unambiguous requirement.
verdicts.FAIL: Direct evidence contradicts a cited unambiguous requirement or required artifact cannot be read.
verdicts.UNSPECIFIED: Definition leaves choice open, conflicting, or observation insufficient; record reason and do not turn into failure.
verdicts.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Execution/behavior beyond static editable OpenPencil design or expressly free artifact properties.

order: Read saved original designs using unmodified original OpenPencil reader
Inspect native graph and render/visible geometry
Compare independently against these criteria, then compare normalized results with one another
evidence_policy.numeric_tolerance: Graph measurements target exact source values; <=0.01px arithmetic/serialization noise and <=1/255 channel rounding allowed. Larger deviations need explicit explanation. Raster glyph bounds/antialiasing are not numerical geometry evidence.
evidence_policy.overall: PASS only if all applicable hard criteria pass. Any hard FAIL => FAIL. Explicit unmeasurable requirements => unresolved/UNSPECIFIED rather than assumed PASS. Record per-artifact and cross-artifact results separately.

criteria.requirement: Saved file opens with unmodified original OpenPencil reader; editable design rather than raster or renamed arbitrary JSON.
criteria.check: Read original saved file before reports; inspect native graph and editable text/shapes; opening failure is FAIL.

criteria.requirement: One clear page contains ten separately named component/frame groups: closed, opening, loading, ready, active, scroll-end, selected, empty, error, disabled.
criteria.check: Match by story name, not generated ID or outer position. All ten required.

criteria.requirement: Label, input, visible overlay surface, clipped viewport, listbox, individual keyed options, and status remain separate, understandable editable parts. Listbox, viewport and surface are distinct.
criteria.check: Check node hierarchy/names and independent editable geometry/text. Do not require a particular naming syntax or native reusable-component mechanism. Hidden popup parts may be absent in closed variants.

criteria.requirement: Each case uses exact inputs/results/activeKey/value of its stories.json entry; seven result labels/order Berlin,Hamburg,München,Dresden,Köln,Wien,Zürich; only München disabled. active=hamburg, scroll-end=zuerich, selected value=berlin/query Berlin.
criteria.check: Compare visible text and structural keyed option identity; active is not a committed value. Absence of optional value is distinct from null if represented as data; native metadata schema is unspecified.

criteria.requirement: Popup hidden and takes no space for closed/opening/selected/disabled; visible for loading/ready/active/scroll-end/empty/error.
criteria.check: Check rendering and visible bounds; hidden retained nodes acceptable. Opening uses focus border despite hidden popup.

criteria.requirement: Component/input width 320; label height 20; labelGap 8; input height 44; popup same left/width as input and top=input bottom+8. Visible list viewport min(count*32,160); rows fixed 32; loading/empty/error popup one 32px message row. Status height20 and top=visible popup bottom+8 else=input bottom+8.
criteria.check: Normalize to component label/input local origin. Input border-box; input inline padding12, border1,radius8; options vertical padding6/inline12; no list/content margin/padding or list bullets. Check values from original graph; distinguish node line box from glyph ink bounds.

criteria.requirement: Inter, font14,lineHeight20; status font12,lineHeight20. Surface white; text #172B4D; muted #64748B; border #CBD5E1; focus #2563EB; highlight #EAF2FF; disabled #94A3B8; error #B91C1C. Input surface white border1 radius8; popup white border0 radius8 shadow 0 2px 8px #0003.
criteria.check: Check exact sRGB values modulo lossless color conversion; native equivalent shadow acceptable. Focus border in opening/loading/ready/empty/error (including active/scroll-end); normal border closed/selected/disabled. Placeholder muted; disabled input text disabled; disabled München text disabled; active only highlighted; status muted except error red.

criteria.requirement: Label Stadt auswählen; empty query shows placeholder Stadt suchen …; other input text exact query. Status: closed/disabled empty; opening Suche wird geöffnet.; loading Städte werden geladen.; ready/active/scroll-end 7 Städte verfügbar.; selected Ausgewählt: Berlin.; empty Keine Städte gefunden.; error Städte konnten nicht geladen werden. Loading/empty/error repeat their status as popup message.
criteria.check: Compare Unicode strings including ellipsis, umlauts and punctuation; ignore descriptive annotations outside component. Status remains named even when empty.

criteria.requirement: Results viewport clips overflow; all seven result layers remain editable. scroll-end must actually show final active Zürich within viewport, using a content offset if needed; rows must not shrink.
criteria.check: Inspect original clip settings, content bounds and rendered image. Seven*32=224 vs160 viewport. At scroll-end an ordinary fully bottom-aligned list has offset64, but exact offset is not mandatory if final row is visible and no other hard rule is violated. Hidden rows may not be deleted.

criteria.requirement: Represent label,status,active and disabled styles; semantic listbox/options belong to Autocomplete, overlay/scroll have no independent selection.
criteria.check: Inspect understandable layer annotations/structure; active Hamburg or Zürich highlighted and München disabled; no obligation for executing ARIA on canvas.

criteria.requirement: Definitions must remain unchanged; exporter records necessary missing or contradictory specification instead of silently inventing it.
criteria.check: Compare preregistered SHA256s after creation; read builder reports only after direct artifact inspection. A report claim cannot override artifact evidence.

ambiguities.decision: Font weight/style, exact glyph baseline/input vertical centering and font file/version are not explicitly fixed. Do not invent exact baselines or pixel-identical glyph rasterization.
CSS placeholder muted and disabled input color disabled coexist. Placeholder stays muted under ordinary CSS; do not require disabled-placeholder recoloring absent a rule.
Height/content mandated; precise text inset/color beyond inherited component styles not explicitly specified as option. Report variations without inventing option styling.

No scrollbar appearance/width specified. Default ready/active scroll offset not numerically fixed; normal document flow starts at top, but only scroll-end explicit reveal is a hard endpoint constraint.

No OpenPencil metadata schema, exact node type, key-name syntax, component-instance type, or complete hidden-popup retained structure mandated. Must remain understandable/editable and preserve result identities.
Explicit token20 applies to status even at font12. Empty status has empty text; native lack of drawable empty text node may be represented by named group/part.
Viewport overflow clipping mandated; popup radius8 mandated. Definition does not explicitly require overflow hidden on surface or a particular clipping shape.

out_of_scope: Interactive combobox preview; runtime keyboard/input/IME/provider sequencing; ARIA execution/screenreader behavior; web/HTML/TypeScript implementation
Free outside arrangement, page title, descriptive annotations
Generated technical IDs, byte equality, archive ordering/timestamps, implementation helper scripts

cross_artifact_comparison.normalization: Match ten story names; compare component-local geometry, parts, text, visible styling, clipping and editability. Ignore exterior translation/arrangement, descriptions, technical IDs and representation details with equivalent editable semantics.
cross_artifact_comparison.classifications: For each difference: source-constrained divergence (which artifact fails), unspecified design/adapter choice, out-of-scope difference, or unresolved observation. Matching artifacts do not prove source compliance; differing artifacts do not automatically fail reproducibility.
cross_artifact_comparison.reproducibility: Report whether all source-determined observable properties agree and satisfy the definition, plus explicit open choices. Do not require byte equality.
